description.ko: 하나의 컴파일러 바이너리로 통합 검사가 끝난 시점을 보존한다. 이후 작업 트리 변경의 검증을 뜻하지 않는다.
description.en: Preserve one coherent compiler/test checkpoint without certifying later working-tree changes.

binary.execution_scope: Local host execution; not proof of every target platform.

source_snapshot.working_tree: Includes uncommitted development changes. Git HEAD alone is not the tested source snapshot.
source_snapshot.identity_boundary: All526 recorded compiler/runtime/library/test/tool/Unicode-data and English catalog input files plus the compiler binary stayed unchanged across one complete138-test CTest invocation. Later generated documentation refreshes and subsequent implementation are separate changes.

ctest.note: One local macOS ARM64 development checkpoint; the immutable copied log contains138 passing tests. Ordinary temporary CTest logs may be replaced by later targeted runs.

task_owned.scope: Owned-only captures/results, one native thread per admitted worker, retained Scope observation loans and explicit/retrying drain.20 closed operations plus5 cancellation aliases and deadline_after are present; Task.wait is an additional noncatalog convenience. No TaskId, workerless ready/failed, borrowed workers, nested scopes, pools, groups or detach are certified.

task_resources.scope: File ownership/worker IO/Drop plus monotonic time and blocking sleep. This is not async suspension.

thread_safety.scope: Sealed derived Send/Sync, transitive effects and cleanup, narrow audited IO admission.

bytes.scope: Prior endian/bit/copy helpers plus fallible owning buffers and strict UTF8 adapters; named Byte scalar argument controls preserve historical0.2 introduction. Source buffer operations validate full extents/reserve before mutation; UTF8 decoder documents revalidation and copying.

float_bits.scope: Exact f16/bf16/f32/f64 raw representation and closed numeric-conversion verifier, not future floating source utilities.

range.scope: Seven descriptor inspection operations and preserved source bounds after iteration.

selected_gates.ordered: The remaining registered Ordered gate passed in274.21seconds after CTest resume on the unchanged snapshot; complete catalog iterator coverage remains separate.

task_scope.scope: Admission close, active count including prepared work, Open/Closing status, nonowning ScopeError.Failure and prepared-before-close commit. Failure injection verifies retained owners; no Drained owner state is fabricated.

floating.scope: Exact classification/sign/magnitude/next/total-order/format constants over f16,bf16,f32,f64; existing f32/f64 signum preserves signed zero and NaN. Shared canonical FloatClass reexports and imported generic constant inference are exercised.

char_scalar.scope: Char.from_u32/to_u32 validate before char construction; invalid payload retained exactly. CoreError.Char bridges to the Error interface.

unicode.scope: Explicit imported Unicode scalar/ASCII/code-unit/escape functions plus50 Unicode17 UCD property, simple/default full-case and name functions. Private readonly tables do not perform string segmentation, normalization, locale/context casing, collation or bidi layout.

task_convenience.scope: is_cancel_requested, fallible independent cancellation observer and checked monotonic deadline_after; no async scheduler or coroutine suspension.

closure_consume.scope: Generated FnOnce entry consumes its whole owning environment into independent locals once. Ordinary projected/borrowed/custom-Drop field move restrictions remain; Fn/FnMut behavior is unchanged.

boolean.scope: Explicit import boolean, integer0/1 and nonzero policies, eager/lazy ownership, strict parsing, fallible text and transactional bounded output. Source BooleanError is distinct from conceptual AllocError/BufferError.

integer.scope: Explicit import integer with checked/wrapping/saturating/overflowing arithmetic, bits and magnitude helpers over8..128bit and native-sized integers. IntegerArithmeticError is nominally distinct from canonical IntegerError; no canonical facade is certified.

unicode_ucd.scope: Pinned byte-exact upstream data, complete Unicode license/notice and explicit UTF8/LF generator IO. Full-case mappings are isolated scalar default mappings, not contextual string transforms.

browser_check.cleanup: English restored; temporary browser tab closed; localhost server exited successfully on KeyboardInterrupt.
browser_check.boundary: Current138-test checkpoint and3797-declaration API page plus30-type error table checked in both languages. This does not establish every table row visually or later source additions.

excluded_future_work: The full synchronous CPU catalog remains incomplete; passing gates and public declaration counts do not establish every documented signature.
TaskId, workerless ready/failed, borrowed Task roots/results, nested/local/pool executors, groups/composition/detach remain future synchronous0.3 work.
Canonical Char/Integer namespaces are not broadened by explicit unicode/integer source alternatives.
Whole-string Unicode normalization/segmentation, locale/context casing and collation remain separate CPU contracts.
GPU-only operations remain deferred; suspending Task/async APIs target0.4 by user decision.
This local macOS ARM64 snapshot does not establish latest-source Linux or Windows execution.
Performance-changing optimization stays held until final Claude advice.
